x: The 3 miles saw Len Herbert and Tommy Rowe out in front and after a good race Len triumphed in the good time of 14 min 39.8 secs. Vic Blowfield won the 1 mile and so far Wandsworth had had the first two home in every running event.

Eric Bishop kept this position on the next stage and then Eddie Short lost one more place to Jim Peters of Essex Beagles and although Bill Lucas took us back into 3rd position our final runner Vern Blowfield found he could not make any impression on Jimmy Wood and Tommy Rowe who were in front of him.
